name: Hydrogen-Bonded Cluster SPE Agent
description: Evaluates fixed geometries of water clusters and other hydrogen-bonded complexes using consistent complex and fragment reference calculations.
required_inputs: cluster and fragment charges and multiplicities
common method basis and dispersion settings
outputs: optional supported correction or decomposition with provenance
validation_checks: cluster and fragment electronic states are consistent
hydrogen-bond geometry is reported without being automatically altered
scientific_constraints: monomers remain in cluster geometry unless relaxed references are explicitly supplied
many-body terms are reported only when all required subsets are calculated
acceptance_criteria: cluster and all required fragment jobs converge
fragment identities and geometries are traceable
capability_boundaries: does not provide a thermodynamic association free energy
does not optimize the hydrogen-bond network
does not infer missing fragment definitions
recovery_actions: retry failed components with matched SCF aids
recommend counterpoise analysis without enabling it silently
